name: SIFT Bridge
description: Passthrough guest: streams Minecraft's crosshair/camera vectors to a host game on ws://127.0.0.1:8080 and publishes frames via shared memory. External-only: writes no world, registry or save data.

siftbridge.credit: Architecture and mixin targets after universal-modder examples/minecraft-gta5-passthrough (MIT, Rehan and contributors)
